lesson.working_title: Visibility Actions: What They Are and How to Practice Them

options.title: Shared Evidence
options.carrier: scene-owned paper-cut illustrations linking work, intentional action, audience, practice, and support
options.layout_family: people fields, evidence bridges, verb paths, action illustrations, quiet ripples, and practice sketches
options.thesis: Visibility makes existing work easier for the right people to encounter and understand.
options.motion_logic: Evidence hands off, named relationships draw, and the narrated action enters at its word cue.

milestones.label: Connection without visibility
milestones.visual_event: two people connect while useful work stays separate

milestones.label: Evidence enters shared view
milestones.visual_event: contribution and potential move toward named audiences

milestones.label: Place, Link, Build
milestones.visual_event: three verbs rise as distinct steps toward reputation

milestones.label: Concrete actions
milestones.visual_event: present, share, ask, stretch, mentor, and teach use different illustrations

milestones.label: Quiet and purposeful
milestones.visual_event: one useful moment holds the center while performance language recedes

milestones.label: Test and support
milestones.visual_event: one action moves through 30 days and reflection into visible direction

options.title: Reputation Garden
options.carrier: small visibility actions become planted evidence, roots, shoots, and a support canopy
options.layout_family: organic full-frame growth illustrations with different plant structures
options.thesis: Consistent useful actions create conditions for a reputation to grow.
options.motion_logic: Seeds land, roots connect contribution to identity, and three practice shoots develop into one tested branch.

milestones.label: Work below the surface
milestones.visual_event: existing value sits as a visible root system

milestones.label: Intentional placement
milestones.visual_event: one action seed lands near a named audience

milestones.label: Visible contribution
milestones.visual_event: work, growth, and value become three shoots

milestones.label: Quiet consistency
milestones.visual_event: one plant develops without a stage or spotlight

milestones.label: Three tailored drafts
milestones.visual_event: three different shoots represent share, ask, and offer

milestones.label: Support canopy
milestones.visual_event: one tested action connects to people who can support it

options.title: Open Windows
options.carrier: work exists inside a building while purposeful windows reveal specific evidence to specific people
options.layout_family: architectural cutaways, thresholds, rooms, and exterior audiences
options.thesis: Visibility opens deliberate windows onto real work without turning a career into a stage.
options.motion_logic: Windows open only for named evidence and audiences; one window remains open for the 30-day test.

milestones.label: Work behind a wall
milestones.visual_event: valuable work occupies a private room

milestones.label: Useful windows
milestones.visual_event: work, growth, and value become separate openings

milestones.label: Different actions
milestones.visual_event: present, ask, stretch, and mentor inhabit different rooms

milestones.label: No spotlight
milestones.visual_event: one modest window communicates a useful moment

milestones.label: Three possible openings
milestones.visual_event: share, ask, and offer take different window proportions

milestones.label: A supportable view
milestones.visual_event: one tested window aligns future direction with supporters

rejected.reason: The growth metaphor has continuity but risks making every action feel like another decorative plant state.
The visibility metaphor is clear, but repeated rooms and openings would reintroduce container repetition.

selection.rationale: Shared Evidence best answers the owner rejection: it removes persistent chrome and repeated boxes while giving each teaching idea a purpose-built, narration-synced illustration in one coherent material language.
